summary: A timely, playable list: big tech is free, Aramco and Meta take thought, TSMC, Broadcom and SpaceX are the stretch. The data around it is messy enough to fix before it runs.
reasons: Casual found 7 (Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Nvidia, Facebook, Aramco) before Tesla #11, Samsung #12, Berkshire #15, Walmart #17 and Exxon used up the lives; good near misses
Countries are accepted answers ('united states' costs a life), PetroChina is duplicated, and top-10 alias lists are full of products, subsidiaries and article titles
Not Blitz-ready: only 19 entries carry a value
